items.title: The Lakers beat the Clippers 103-87 to improve to 4-1 on the season. LA won despite playing without Luka Dončić and Ziaire Williams. Collin Sexton scored 21 points, and Quentin Grimes had a team-high 23 points in the win. The Lakers will play the Warriors next on Friday night.
